thread:
Pri (Content): We wrapped the New Horizon Analytics interview this AM. Raw + notes in Drive: https://redwood.app/drive/newhorizon-raw. Marked a 75s hero clip and a 40s technical clip. Need final hero quote + legal OK for the benchmark chart before publish.

Max (PMM): Sweet. Paste the one-liner hero you want and I'll draft the landing deck + social blurbs. Also plan to tie a webinar 2 weeks out.

Carmen (Producer): Uploaded rough cut. Hero clip timestamp 00:50-02:05. If quote is locked by Wed EOD we can hit the Friday publish. I also need a confirmed byline and headshot.

Jordan (AE): New Horizon wants inbound leads from the CTA to go to their Customer Success Ops first, then to our Enterprise queue if no response in 36h. Also they asked for campaign=newh_launch_q3_2026 and a tracking token.

crm-bot: To add routing, provide comma-separated key=value pairs. Example: lead_source=case_study,owner=team-x.

Jordan (AE): Use payload: lead_source=newh_case,owner=newh-cs-ops,fallback_owner=redwood-enterprise,followup_delay=36h,campaign=newh_launch_q3_2026,token=newh_tok_0926

Elise (Legal): I read the transcript. Two redlines: 1) they quoted a specific percent improvement for model cost  we need to redact unless New Horizon signs off on the exact number  replace with "meaningful cost improvements"; 2) a partner vendor name needs removal. Send the edited hero/bench text and I'll review.

Pri (Content): Draft hero (redacted): "Redwood enabled meaningful cost improvements on inference and sped up our release cycles." Draft bench caption: "Benchmark shows improved cost-efficiency and faster iteration times" (chart will be schematic, no raw numbers).

Max (PMM): Slight tweak for cadence: "Redwood unlocked meaningful inference cost improvements and accelerated our release cadence." That reads better as a headline.

Elise (Legal): Approved that phrasing, with vendor redaction confirmed. Elise (Legal) :white_check_mark:

Carmen (Producer): Nice. I'll slot that into the landing and ask design for the schematic benchmark (labelled axes, no numeric ticks). Pri, can you confirm the attribution line and a short 10-word bio?

Pri (Content): Attribution: "Anika Rao, VP of ML, New Horizon Analytics". Bio: "Leads ML platform and production-scale model deployments."

Jordan (AE): Confirming CRM payload above. Also New Horizon asked that demo requests get a custom subject line in the HubSpot ticket: "NH Case Lead - inbound from case page". Can we wire that?

crm-bot: Routing rule queued to staging. Added custom ticket subject to payload: ticket_subject=NH Case Lead - inbound from case page. Reminder: deploy to production 45 minutes before publish window.

Max (PMM): Webinar plan: target 2026-09-10 for a 30-min customer-led session + 15 Q&A. We'll add webinar CTA on the case page. Carmen, please prep speaker bullets and co-presenter notes.

Carmen (Producer): On it. I'll request headshot and consent for the schematic bench from Anika. Also creating a 60s hero cut for social and a 15s teaser for Twitter/X.

Elise (Legal): Once the landing has the final quote + schematic, tag me and I'll do a final pass. Approving the current copy.

Pri (Content): Great. Final checklist: quote approved, vendor removed, routing staged with token, design briefed. I'll push the final landing draft to the doc and tag everyone for a last look by Thursday AM. :rocket:
